findings.location: Decision 1 and Consequences — “under any global setting” / “in every project”
findings.problem: The decision treats a rendered harness `ask` as a project-wide guarantee. The accepted floor decision says guarantees that matter must be enforced in workbench code, and the harness spec says a harness without `permissions` receives only a warning and instruction. A rendered rule therefore cannot guarantee this prompt in every attached project.
findings.suggestion: Narrow the guarantee to harnesses that provide and honor permissions, or decide and specify code-level enforcement for the stated guarantee; retain the best-effort matcher limitation.

findings.location: Decision 4 — instruction to alter the earlier accepted record’s status line
findings.problem: It directs a change to an already accepted decision record. Project policy says accepted decisions are never rewritten; the decisions index supports a full supersession status but not changing part of an accepted record’s status to annotate a successor.
findings.suggestion: Leave the earlier record unchanged and have this successor explicitly state that it supersedes only Question 1’s option-2 choice for the three named commands.

summary: The proposed decision has two policy/guarantee conflicts that need resolution before it can be relied on.
